English (see ui_strings.py): The icons along the bottom of   the screen are Progress Icons.  There are many kinds. Pick a    practice icon and the whole teamdoes that practice. Pitching    practice does little for        batters, and batting practice   little for pitchers. Some icons have special effects too, so usethem well!
Text and the schedule can be    fast-forwarded. Recommended for anyone who wants to keep the    game moving briskly!
Players going pro train in secret until graduation day.|If it goes well, they may grow even more.|No more practice orders now, so look forward to graduation!

On the 1st of every month you   give practice orders on their   own screen. Once an order       reaches a set value, it switchesto Auto by itself. The value    differs by item; for example,   Trajectory switches at +1.
In 'Lineup Setup' on the Data|screen you can set your lineup,|usage and team policy.

Baseball Tools, the items that  grow a player, can be used only once per player. Books, the     items that give a special       ability, can also be used only  once per player. Think hard     before you use these two!
Some players already have a|special ability when they join.|Check the Data screen to see|who has one.

Installing gear raises Ground   Lv. The higher the Ground Lv.,  the better the practice results.Each piece of gear also has a   practice of its own, so adding  gear may bring new practice     progress icons. Check your gear on the Data screen.
'Lv. from gear' and 'Lv. from soil' make up Ground Lv.|Maxing out just one of them will not|bring Ground Lv. to MAX.

The soil that forms the base of a school's ground comes in two  kinds: white soil and black     soil. As the school's reputationrises, the ground changes to    black soil. Once the base is    black soil, the base value of   Ground Lv. goes up a lot!
The share of bad weather is the same all over Japan, but the    chance of snow differs by       region. Use your items wisely.
Stop on a white panel and you|may get a good event, or a|bad one.
Stop on a blue panel and an|event that helps the team|happens. Aim for them!
Stop on a red panel and an eventthat hurts the team happens. Trynot to step on them.
Stop on a green panel to let|your players rest. Manage their|condition well and train|efficiently.
Stop on a Schedule Panel and twonew branches appear, so you can pick a route from three. Aim forit when the schedule ahead looksweak.
Stop on a yellow panel and the  progress icon you have selected gets bonus experience. Aim for  them! But if the selected icon  is not a practice, an event     happens instead.

Record Points are earned from   match results. You can spend    them on Baseball Tools, items   and more. As you pile up wins, avendor who sells items visits   the team regularly, and that is when you can use them. Save up  lots and spend lots!

At camp, you can have the       players who are fired up that   day aim for a special ability.  When camp starts, the practice  icons switch to ones with       special abilities of their own. Some practices carry several of them. If there are several, one is picked at random. Which      progress icons you bring into   camp is very important.

About branching after a match:  the upper route is for a win.   The lower route is for a draw ora loss. In practice games and inofficial games from July, the   branch after a match can change your public reputation.
Players to watch are chosen from|the starters. A player chosen as|Spotlight Player gets more|playing time than usual.
When public reputation rises,   you get more progress icons and a better schedule this week. Newrecruits are stronger, and goingpro gets easier. All good       things!
Setting a training policy       changes which practice icons    tend to appear. Choose from fourtypes, keeping in mind the idealplayer you want to raise.
A growth report after a practiceprogress icon combines two kindsof experience: what comes from  the practice items set for each player, and what the icon you   chose earned.
In a match you give players all kinds of orders, like pitching  inside or going for a hit and   run. What to pick in each       situation is up to the manager.
The bigger the number on a      tactic icon, the stronger the   effect. The number depends on   how much each player trusts you,and it changes with every at-   bat, based on that trust.

Every player has a Unique       Tactic. It is the differently   colored tactic at the far right of the tactic icons during a    match. Unique Tactics are based on personality, and some are    rare. Each player can use his   only once per match. When to useit is the manager's call. Note  that some have no effect,       depending on the player's       condition or the pitcher's      state.

A messenger can be used up to 3 times per game. In extra        innings, you can use one once   per inning. A messenger's effectdepends on the player's year andpersonality. Whom to send and   when is up to the manager. The  number is limited, so be        careful.
Don't Mind sends the catcher to the mound. It calms the         pitcher's nerves. It can be usedup to 2 times per game.
Big Cheer speeds up everyone's  baserunning on offense and      ball-chasing on defense. Cheer  on your hard-working players    with all your heart!
Super Pumped makes Special|Training panels easier to clear!|Blue panel effects also get a|little stronger.

Practice with a combined        progress icon makes players     train harder than ever, so they earn lots of experience. The    more ★ stars, the greater the   effect. Also, a combined        progress icon always becomes a  1-day icon.
